task_description: Fix visual (colour + cell-merge/overflow) fidelity of the SARS report converter, then refactor the data-specific outputs into reusable data-driven templates: separate data from static chrome, extract each report's data into documented per-type JSON schemas, encode the deterministic competency-band background colour, make table structure elastic (wrap long cells), rename templates by level+purpose (with private/overall/government variants), and expose a callable template-maker API that takes data and returns HTML or a rendered PDF. Preserve the existing 100% text-fidelity guarantee throughout.
